67.title: [P2] Batch storage reconciliation instead of scanning the full corpus
67.body:
<!-- ralph-milestone-finding pr:61 id:76bbe2537324c0ac7ed2 -->
## Context

**Source:** automated milestone review of PR #61
**Milestone:** Phase 1: Core Profile API (Tracer Bullet)
**Reviewed head:** `aa63f8a3c103ac93e75c485e2b84e4918cf944ac`
**Severity:** P2
**Location:** `apps/api/src/files/services/meeting-file-deletion-reconciliation.service.ts:108`

## Finding

Every minute the reconciler loads all stale storage entries, places every key into one Prisma `IN` query, then loads all old READY rows and checks them serially. File growth can make reconciliation run continuously or exceed PostgreSQL query/parameter limits. Process filesystem and database records in bounded batches with a per-run budget or durable cursor.

## Definition of done

- Fix the root cause without weakening existing behavior or tests.
- Add or update regression coverage for the failure path.
- Run the relevant checks from AGENTS.md and the Ralph configuration.
- Keep the change focused on this finding; do not create a pull request.

The existing draft PR will be updated and reviewed again after all review findings are resolved.
